services.desc: It's no secret that women face unique challenges in their daily lives and our team at Emerge Jiu Jitsu is here to help you prepare for them all. Our Women's Self-Defense class is a program taught by women and designed for women. No matter what situation you're hoping to prepare for, we're here to make it happen. We are committed to helping women across Vancouver and Battle Ground face life with complete confidence and we can't wait for you to get started. Our goal in this program is to prepare the women in our community for anything life throws their way. This program is led by women because who else knows the dangers we face? Together, we work on the skills and situational awareness needed
